items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Well I'm in that X-Squad with him... I played the saxophone. If they were short of the drummer I played the drums. Yeah. The Albert system too.

ctx.x: Yeah I used to play this. I remember when T-Boy was the manager. T-Boy.

Well I'm in that X-Squad with him. You see X-Squad book you'll see Manny Gabriel. I'm playing saxophone not clarinet. Because we used Piku. When Piku didn't play then I played or John Cash. I played the saxophone. If they were short of the drummer I played the drums. Yeah. The Albert system too.
